question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- Now I need to find which top-level containers have any item with total accumulated quantity > 500
-- And return the names of both the containers and the items

WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_id,
        CAST(p.id AS BIGINT) AS current_id,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS accumulated_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        h.accumulated_qty * pr.qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        top_id,
        current_id,
        SUM(accumulated_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM hierarchy
    GROUP BY top_id, current_id
)
SELECT 
    t.top_id,
    tp.name AS container_name,
    t.current_id AS item_id,
    ip.name AS item_name,
    t.total_qty
FROM totals t
JOIN packaging tp ON tp.id = t.top_id
JOIN packaging ip ON ip.id = t.current_id
WHERE t.total_qty > 500
ORDER BY t.top_id, t.current_id
